title: Renewals as their own record
transcript:
Consultant: How do you handle a renewal today?
Client: We clone the original opportunity, which is wrong, because then the
reporting counts it as new business and the numbers are inflated.
Consultant: So a renewal is not really an opportunity.
Client: It is its own thing. We need a renewal record type of its own,
separate from opportunity, linked back to the account.
Consultant: A new object then.
Client: A new object. That is exactly what we need.

expected.note: A new object, not a field. Field name must be null.
